snippet.title: Say When! Official trailer
snippet.description: Our game, “Say When!”, is almost here! We’re making an “ultra-realistic”, WarioWare inspired cheese grating simulator for the Playdate. The most scientifically accurate cheese-grating simulation game ever made.
